persona: 38-year-old car and bike guy, dry humour, buys a few tees a year

designs.why: Reads from across the room: big title, clean curve, and the dragster running off the top edge gets the joke across. The vehicles are nicely drawn and I'd recognise the E-Type, Golf and Vespa. The minivan sitting off the curve with its own dot is the best gag, because it's the one good decision. The one-ink line art looks grown-up, not novelty. The $50 price is fair if the print is crisp.
designs.fix: Make the minivan's dot bigger, and maybe ring it, so the off-curve punchline lands from 3 m. Right now it's a small dot at the van's top-left corner and easy to miss.
